The vertical axis is pH, and the horizontal axis is the volume of HCl added/mL. The curve starts at a higher pH and first decreases slowly as HCl is added; near about 23–24 mL, a steep vertical drop appears, and the midpoint of the steep drop section is slightly less than 25 mL. Reasoning: The titration equivalence point corresponds to the midpoint of the steep drop section, so the equivalence point volume V_eq is slightly less than 25.0 mL. Because V_eq is slightly less than 25.0 mL, M_base is slightly less than 0.125 M.
